Красным — только тревога: FPS упал замет: Red means an alert only: FPS dropped well below normal, the graphics card reached 85 °C, ping of 150 ms or more, device battery at 15% or less. The program does not show the CPU temperature: Windows does not provide it without a third-party driver, and the program does not install such drivers.
Мыши, гарнитуры и клавиатуры HyperX, Ste: The program reads mice, headsets and keyboards from HyperX, SteelSeries, Corsair, Razer, ASUS ROG, Glorious, Endgame Gear, Zowie and Pulsar, and Logitech G435 headsets itself — with the same battery request the brand’s app uses. PlayStation controllers are only listened to: they send their battery level on their own. Devices whose protocol the program doesn’t know get no requests: an unknown command could mess up their settings. For those, the section says which brand app shows the battery and whether it’s installed.
Программа только читает: ничего не стави: The program only reads: it installs nothing and changes no device settings. The battery is checked every 4 minutes, just as rarely during games: it changes slowly, and frequent requests would wake the mouse and headset. The exception is the Logitech G435 headset: reading it cuts its sound for about 0.4 s, so it is read at most every 20 minutes and only when it is silent (outside games) or in the first 90 seconds after a game starts.

Nothing is installed and nothing changes in device settings. For HyperX, Razer, SteelSeries, Corsair and other brands with their own protocol, check the battery in their apps. The Logitech G435 headset is read less often — at most every 20 minutes and only when it's silent or when a game starts: reading cuts its sound for a split second.
